_comment: Manual fallbacks for Sinnoh locations the auto-extractor cannot handle: no distinct DP highlight (wayward-cave shares Route 206; victory-road shares the Pokemon League map), or a map-revision mismatch that yields an empty/bogus diff (oreburgh-city, eterna-forest, route-228 — their highlight PNGs are a different rendering than the 39-file base group). The other 64 Sinnoh regions are auto-extracted. Tile space, 27x21 grid, 8px tiles.
